people.name: Eliada

people.name: Hadadezer

people.name: Zobah
people.line: An Aramean kingdom, enemy of Israel during David's reign

translations.web: God raised up an adversary to him, Rezon the son of Eliada, who had fled from his lord Hadadezer king of Zobah.
translations.bsb: And God raised up against Solomon another adversary, Rezon the son of Eliada, who had fled from his master, Hadadezer king of Zobah,
